hero.title: The Mōchirīī Tome
introBody: The Tome explains how members communicate, join events, help others & handle problems.
Use it before your first event & whenever a rule needs checking.

intro.title: Rules for Every Member
body: The same rules apply across time zones, playstyles, parties & guild channels.
They cover conduct, event planning, disputes & rank recognition.

tenets.title: Guild Tenets
tenets.description: These six tenets guide decisions in parties, chat & guild spaces.
tenets.caption: Each one names a behavior members can use during play.

items.title: Coordination
items.description: Agree on roles, follow team leaders & post changes when possible.

items.title: Help
items.description: Offer help, explain the task & let others choose.

items.title: Respect
items.description: Address the issue without insults & allow mistakes to be corrected.

items.title: Reliability
items.description: Keep commitments or post an update before plans change.

items.title: Practice
items.description: Share builds & mechanics in steps others can test.

items.title: Fair Play
items.description: Win without taunting, lose without blame & follow event rules.

etiquette.title: Guild Etiquette
etiquette.description: These rules cover chat, mentoring & disputes during guild activity.

blocks.title: Chat
items: Greet new members & answer the question they asked.
Avoid jokes that target a member. Stop when someone opts out.

blocks.title: Mentoring
items: Find out what the member already knows.
Share one step at a time & let them choose their own build.

blocks.title: Disputes
items: Move disagreements to private messages before they spread.
Ask middle leadership about routine concerns. Hall Leaders handle repeated or hall-wide issues.
State what happened, own your part & agree on the next step.

blocks.title: Guild Code
items: Keep public channels suitable for all guild members.
Respect time zones, schedules & announced breaks.
Invite members to events without pressuring them.
Report harassment, safety concerns, or repeated conflict to leadership.

rhythm.title: Rhythm
rhythm.description: Rhythm is our pace: enough structure to meet & grow, enough ease to keep play restful.
rhythm.caption: Mōchirīī favors patient participation & leaves room for real life.
rhythm.note: Post plans early, communicate changes plainly & keep the pace in reach.

items.title: Hall Runs
items.description: Posted with time zones, goals & RSVP notes when planning is needed; parties form with light role notes & clear start times.

items.title: Raffles
items.description: A thank-you for presence & spirit; the current raffle status stays public & clearly labeled.

items.title: Notices
items.description: Patch notes that affect builds & guild decisions are shared with enough lead time to plan.

items.title: Quiet Time
items.description: Roam, farm, craft, or chat while staying connected to the guild at a pace that leaves room for real life.

recognition.title: Rank Recognition
recognition.description: Ranks reflect conduct & contribution observed over time as a guild member.

items.title: Follow-through
items.description: Keep commitments & post updates when plans change.

items.title: Contribution
items.description: Answer questions, share tested information, or help organize parties.

items.title: Conduct
items.description: Handle setbacks without insults, blame, or public arguments.
